name: DreamMaker Bath & Kitchen of Chester County
hours: Mon to Fri 9 am to 5 pm.
description: DreamMaker Bath & Kitchen of Chester County is a full-service remodeler in Chester Springs, PA, handling design, selections, and installation with its in-house team for kitchens, baths, basements, and more.

hero.eyebrow: Chester Springs, PA | Design through installation
hero.headline: Remodel the rooms you actually use
hero.sub: Full-service kitchen and bath remodeling for Chester County, with design, selections, and every trade handled by DreamMaker's in-house team.

offerings.heading: Rooms DreamMaker <mark>rebuilds.</mark>
items: Kitchens, from layout and cabinetry to counters and lighting
Bathrooms, showers, and accessible baths built for daily use
Basements, home offices, closets, laundry rooms, and finish carpentry
BBB accredited with an A+ rating

story.heading: One team from concept to completion
paragraphs: DreamMaker of Chester County is an independently, locally owned remodeler that keeps design, product selections, and installation with its own team, so nothing gets lost between a designer and a contractor.
Being part of a national organization adds annual training on the latest products and techniques. The showroom on Pottstown Pike is where the plan starts.

experience.heading: How a remodel runs
items: Meet at the Chester Springs showroom and walk the cabinet and surface options.
Get a design and a fixed scope before demolition starts.
One in-house crew finishes the room, then walks it with you.

feature.heading: Bathrooms built to be lived in
feature.text: Walk-in showers, better storage, and lighting that works at 6 am, designed for how the family uses the room.
